articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Enhanced Reasoning and Multimodal Capabilities
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native multimodal input/output across text, image, audio, and video, and a claimed 3x reduction in hallucination rates on internal benchmarks. The model introduces a new "deliberative alignment" architecture that chains internal verification steps before generating final responses, marking a shift toward more reliable agentic AI systems.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which surpasses previous models on GPQA-Diamond, MathOlympiad, and several graduate-level science benchmarks. The model introduces mixture-of-depth routing that dynamically allocates compute during inference, allowing it to match frontier performance at roughly 40% lower serving cost. Google is integrating it across Workspace, Cloud, and its research tools.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 03 humanoid robots have entered full commercial deployment at two BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina, performing parts inspection, kitting, and light assembly tasks alongside human workers. The robots operate autonomously for 18-hour shifts with a reported 97.5% task completion rate, representing one of the first scaled commercial deployments of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Dexterous Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot performing complex manipulation tasks including sorting irregularly shaped objects, folding laundry, and operating standard household appliances. The system uses a vision-language-action model trained on millions of hours of teleoperation data combined with synthetic simulation, enabling zero-shot generalization to novel objects without task-specific fine-tuning.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Agents with Verified Safety Guarantees
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new framework for deploying autonomous AI agents with formal safety guarantees, building on its constitutional AI approach. The system uses a combination of runtime monitoring, sandboxed execution, and mathematical proofs of constraint adherence to ensure agents cannot take irreversible high-impact actions without human approval. The framework is open-sourced and already being adopted by several enterprise customers for automated code deployment and data pipeline management.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its 1.4nm A14 process node has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, utilizing gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. Major customers including Apple, Nvidia, and AMD are expected to ship products on the node by early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trials
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink expanded approval to implant its N2 brain-computer interface in up to 50 additional patients with spinal cord injuries and ALS, following positive results from its initial cohort where patients achieved cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied baselines. The expanded trial will also test bidirectional stimulation for restoring limited sensory feedback, a first for commercial BCI devices.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Autonomous Construction Robot Fleet
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, in collaboration with Hyundai Engineering, demonstrated a fleet of four heterogeneous robots—including a next-generation Atlas humanoid and specialized quadrupeds—autonomously coordinating to perform structural inspection, rebar placement, and site surveying on an active construction site in Seoul. The system uses a centralized task planner with decentralized execution, enabling real-time replanning when site conditions change, and reduced inspection time by 60% compared to manual methods.
